_comment: Data-flow coupling chains for the Phase-19 review gate (resolved 2026-06-17 cross-family consensus). Each chain's files MUST be co-located in ONE review group so a bug whose cause spans them is seen by a single per-group reviewer (the cross-group coupling blind spot). Grounded in actual cross-file imports in eval/ (verified 2026-06-17), not speculation. assertManifestCoverage(args.groups, thisFile) MUST pass before dispatching the Phase-19 gate.

chains.name: safeId path-traversal guard surface
chains.rationale: safeId is defined in lz-eval-aggregate.mjs (line ~201) and imported + relied on as the path-traversal guard by lz-eval-offline-read.mjs (votePath basename) and lz-eval-dataset.mjs (slug). A guard weakness in aggregate or a misuse in either consumer is a defect spanning these files.

chains.name: search-loop API surface
chains.rationale: searchAndStop / staticKsAdapter / dateFilter / parseAvtDate are defined in lz-eval-search-loop.mjs and consumed by lz-eval-offline-read.mjs and lz-eval-traps.mjs; a contract or date-parsing change spans these.

chains.name: aggregate -> offline-read consumption surface
chains.rationale: lz-eval-offline-read.mjs imports a broad set from lz-eval-aggregate.mjs; an invariant assumed in aggregate and relied on in offline-read spans both files.
